FEE INCREASE NOTICE
Due to a statewide, statutory fee increase on August 28, 2026, fees in our office have increased. This impacts all recording documents, marriage licenses, and land surveys/plats. Please click here for more information.
Recorder of Deeds Transparency Portal
These receipts provide more than a financial record, they reflect the transparency of the Recorder of Deeds office to conduct the public’s business openly and accountably. When an office entrusted with collecting and managing public revenue makes those records available, it demonstrates that every dollar matters and that the public deserves to know how its government operates. It is my committment as your Recorder of Deeds to strengthen accountability, protect public trust, and reinforce the principle that your tax dollars are held in stewardship, not secrecy. An open government begins with county offices willing to let the public see not only what we do, but how we responsibly handle the resources entrusted to us.
Christopher L. Wright
Recorder of Deeds
The Recorder’s Office will be closed for the following holidays:
Monday, October 12 - Columbus Day
Wednesday, November 11 - Veterans' Day
Thursday, November 26 - Thanksgiving Day
Friday, November 27 - Day after Thanksgiving
Thursday, December 24 - Christmas Eve
Friday, December 25 - Christmas Day

Mission Statement:
To maintain a perpetual, comprehensive set of public records consisting of real estate deeds, federal and state tax liens, marriage licenses, and all other documents appropriately presented for recording, in an accurate, timely, professional and courteous manner and to ensure a high quality service. Track the flow of revenue through the office in a clear and thorough manner.
In accomplishing this, the Recorder's Office will:
Foster cooperation between county offices.
Provide EXCELLENT customer service.
Engage in regular review processes geared to improve services.
Vision Statement:
To simplify the business of life for our community through innovative solutions, trusted expertise and a fully engaged workforce.

Recorder's Office Home
Responsibilities:
Record and maintain Real Estate transactions.
Issue and maintain Marriage License information.
File and maintain State and Federal Tax Liens.
File and maintain Military Discharge documents.
Effective July 1, 2001, all Uniform Commercial Code filings are done through
the Secretary of State: http://www.sos.mo.gov/ucc
General Office Information:
With the exception of the DD214 disclaimer form, you do not need an open records request to request documents from the Recorder's Office. Please call or email us and we'll be happy to assist.
The Recorder's Office is open between the hours of 8:00 am & 5:00 pm to search records or make copies as needed. (We are open during the lunch hour)
Documents are recorded between the hours of 9:00 am & 4:00 pm.
You may apply for a marriage license between the hours of 8:00 am & 4:00 pm. The fee is $53 for the license or $63 for the license plus a certified copy. Cash (must be exact change) or Card (convenience fee applies to card use). Payment is required at time of application. Please bring exact change as our office does not keep change.
Note: The Recorder's data is not considered official data and is not intended as a substitute for advice from a licensed/legal professional.
Record Notification Service:
Register for a free account and be notified via email anytime a deed is recorded in our office that meets the criteria you provide.
Click here for detailed instructions for signing up. .
Sunshine Requests:
To comply with Missouri Law, the Recorder's Office will facilitate Sunshine Requests, however in most circumstances that is not necessary in this office. Most of the information kept in this office is available publicly, including all Real Estate records and Marriage records (for Divorce records please contact the Circuit Clerk ).
Custodian of Records - Travis Youmans (ext. 3326)
For Sunshine Requests please email the Recorder of Deeds' Office .
